feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: World's fastest ocean liner is sunk to break another record: largest artificial reef
entry.summary: The SS United States broke trans-Atlantic speed records. On Wednesday, it was sunk off the Florida coast and will become a diving destination and home for marine life.

entry.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate race
entry.summary: Democrat Scott Colom has won election to the U.S. Senate in Mississippi, according to a race call by the Associated Press, defeating Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith.

entry.title: Why is gasoline suddenly under $4 a gallon?
entry.summary: The average price of a gallon of gasoline dipped below $4 this week for the first time in months. Does that mean more relief is coming for drivers?

entry.title: Greetings from Senegal, where breakdancers are competing in the Youth Olympics
entry.summary: Senegal's breakdancers have been practicing for their country's historic hosting of the Youth Olympic Games this month. It's the first time Africa is hosting an Olympic event.

entry.title: Kennedy relatives join the fight against Trump's arch, alleging harm to JFK's grave
entry.summary: Nine members of the Kennedy family have joined the legal fight against Trump's D.C. arch, arguing it would disrupt views and cast shadows over their ancestors' graves at Arlington National Cemetery.

entry.title: Actor Stacy Keach, who played a private eye and plenty more, dies at 85
entry.summary: Known as TV's detective Mike Hammer, Keach was a prolific actor on stage and screen. His wide-ranging roles included cops, cowboys and Shakespearean characters.

entry.title: Following big Democratic wins, these swing voters are looking for results
entry.summary: For the swing voters NPR is regularly checking in with as part of its Swing Shift series, the election results brought mixed emotions, as does the pending Democratic control of Congress.

entry.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to a prisoner exchange as talks end with no big breakthrough
entry.summary: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a large exchange of prisoners of war. U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi led to this decision, marking the biggest humanitarian release since the war began in 2022.

entry.title: An Iran-backed trio is accused of plotting attacks on a U.K. base hosting U.S. jets
entry.summary: Iran-backed operatives have been charged over nearly 20 attacks, including a plot on a U.K. base housing U.S. troops. Separately, a U.S. soldier is held in the U.K. on Russia spying claims.

entry.title: Independent Rep. Kevin Kiley says voters want 'checks and balances' in government
entry.summary: Rep. Kevin Kiley, a former Republican turned independent, lost his reelection bid. He discusses what went wrong for the GOP, the challenges of the two-party system and how Congress could work better.
